validation.oos_scope: non-overlapping production replay; each row is the probability the live entry would have produced at that decision with the same absolute refit anchor and the calibration state matured before it

warnings: XGBoost/LightGBM are not part of this native baseline; the ML path currently uses deterministic L2 logistic regression only.
Returns are gross close-to-close observations; this model path does not model execution, spreads, slippage or fees.
The replay scores non-overlapping decisions only; each row uses the absolute refit anchor the live entry would have used.
Calibration is disabled by policy for this shadow path; the reported probability is the raw logistic output and is not a calibrated frequency.
